headline: A family legacy in media: How Emiliano Valdez is reimagining broadcast education at MCAET.
summary: For the last six years, at the Media Center for Art, Education and Technology (MCAET) in Salinas, Director Emiliano Valdez has been quietly building something rare in public education: a place where professional-grade media production, arts education, and hands-on technology…
